items.title: Meet KLING 4.0 | You Call the Shots
items.excerpt: Kling 4.0 arrives in October with Kling 4.0 Flash live now for Ultra yearly subscribers; the model targets filmmakers with up to 30-second generations, many multimodal references and keyframe-level narrative control.

items.title: The Beat | Made with KLING 4.0
items.excerpt: Launch showcase short 'The Beat', created with Kling 4.0, following a drummer's journey back to the stage. Same launch as Kling 4.0 - alternate/visual for that story.

items.title: From Traditional Filmmaking to AI Animation: Diane Shorthouse's Journey with Kling AI
items.excerpt: After 30 years in traditional film and TV, Diane Shorthouse explores how AI can expand what filmmakers create, from safer production to emotional animated storytelling.

items.title: Meta Muse Won? Alibaba's "Seedance Killer" & AI Audio Levels Up!
items.excerpt: Weekly AI video roundup: Meta's Muse video push, Alibaba's new video model pitched as a Seedance rival, and advances in AI audio for creators.

items.title: Block in 3D, refine with node-based AI
items.excerpt: Why Autodesk Flow Studio combines a 3D editor with a node-based AI canvas, and how that maps to a more controllable VFX production workflow.

items.title: It's More Than an AI Clip Tool: An Intro to Topview and Its Cinematic Film Studio
items.excerpt: An introduction to Topview and how its Film Studio helps filmmakers use AI to direct cinematic projects rather than generate random clips. (Possible sponsored/advertorial - verify.)

items.title: Art of the Frame Podcast: The Alan Smithee Round Table - How will AI impact the future of filmmaking?
items.excerpt: Scott Simmons, Katie Hinsen and Michael Kammes discuss how AI tools, unified post software and shifting economics are transforming film and TV production.
